reason: I have run my dining room for years on people, not phones, and my guests want a waiter who knows their name. A brand-new company with no restaurant live yet, asking me to be a pilot, is a lot of risk when my staff already ring every order on the POS.
objection: Will it work with my POS, or will my staff have to type orders in twice? If they do, I have paid R699 a month to make my busiest hours slower.
would_change_my_mind: A direct link to my POS that works, shown running in a restaurant like mine that I can call and ask about.
